Container.Name: darkroom
Container.Overview: Darkroom in one container: the app, the Takeout browser worker and Darkroom's Syncthing together, under the image's init. Before the first start, put deploy/browser/seccomp.json of a release at /boot/config/darkroom/seccomp.json on the server, set Repository to that release's tag instead of latest, and make the appdata folder owned by 99:100 (docs/deploy/one-container.md). It runs on the host network, for Darkroom's Syncthing and its local discovery: port 8000 and Syncthing's 22000 (TCP and UDP) and 21027 (UDP) listen on every address of the server. Keep them off the internet and never forward them.
Container.Requires: The seccomp profile at /boot/config/darkroom/seccomp.json, copied by hand from deploy/browser/seccomp.json of the same release (docs/deploy/one-container.md).

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Darkroom's web UI and API, including the remote browser view. On the host network it listens on 8000 of every address of the server.

Config.Name: Syncthing
Config.Description: Darkroom's Syncthing, which the Pixels connect to. On the host network it listens on 22000 of every address of the server; never forward it.

Config.Name: Syncthing (QUIC)
Config.Description: Darkroom's Syncthing over QUIC. On the host network it listens on 22000 of every address of the server; never forward it.

Config.Name: Syncthing discovery
Config.Description: Syncthing's local discovery, which announces Darkroom's Syncthing on the LAN. On the host network it listens on 21027 of every address of the server; never forward it.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database, the generated secret key and the browser profiles. Back this folder up with the container stopped.

Config.Name: Photo share
Config.Description: The photo share: the people's folders, _inbox and _pixels.

Config.Name: DARKROOM_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The address people open Darkroom at, for links in alerts and the sign-in redirect.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: The sign-in provider (Pocket ID) issuer address.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: The client ID Darkroom has at the sign-in provider.

Config.Name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: The client secret Darkroom has at the sign-in provider.

Config.Name: OIDC_ALLOWED_GROUPS
Config.Description: Groups allowed to sign in, comma-separated.

Config.Name: IMMICH_ADMIN_KEY
Config.Description: An Immich admin API key, for the external-library rescans.

Config.Name: DARKROOM_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Leave empty: Darkroom generates the key into the appdata folder on first start. Set it only to keep the key apart from appdata.

Config.Name: POLL_SECONDS
Config.Description: How often the idle browser worker asks for a job.

Config.Name: BROWSER_CHANNEL
Config.Description: chrome: Google Chrome; chromium: always the bundled Chromium.
